title: Bought this app 6 months ago
body: and with recent update my Premium is gone, they are asking 53USD a month and I lost access to my data as I need to be Premium to download it. Never replied to my emails either. bunch of crooks.
author: mlvrkhn

title: Not recommended
body: Recent update added annual subscription (even if you’ve already paid for premium previously). Now all the premium features are locked again, and the subscription prompt is very intrusive and annoying, which makes the app experience pretty bad. Can’t recommend this unless you want to pay a yearly fee just to not have to deal with the prompts everywhere
author: Sentrino

title: The last update was bad
body: I paid for an upgrade last year to support the developer and also get the backup/restore to iCloud functionality. After the last update it looked like I was using the app for the first time and I was prompted to get a “premium” subscription. I skipped it and now the iCloud backup functionality is locked. Luckily my data is still there so far, but I’m concerned I may lose it now.
author: JulianHidalgoP

title: The subscription ruined the app.
body: I paid for something they promised to be a lifetime premium version of this app, then they updated it and made a subscription for premium, so i lost my premium version of the app i paid for a one time fee. I got scammed...
author: Pologutten

title: Rly great!
body:
This app is pretty great! It does not cost anything and there is no ads! Live it!! You can have as many habits as you want! And you can see back to which days you do the habits! You can see if you reach your goal! It can send you reminders if you want it! And choose how often your goal is to do the thing! 

Asolutly recommend it!😃👌✨
author: doggi dohg

title: Extremely good!
body: You can have unlimited habits without having to pay. Something I love as well is there are NO ads! There is an incredible price for Premium. You can choose how much you pay, but you get the same no matter what you choose. I would recommend the cheapest 😂 It's very easy to handle and is very good for it's free version. Much better than I expected.                 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
